description: R1: the capture view opens in `capturing` before the core answers, then shows the captured name and URI (a11y and OCR), and on a failed capture shows what failed and what to do
notes: capture-delayed.json resolves 300 ms after the capture request. The trigger_hotkey reply is the shell's state the moment the panel is asked to show, so view.phase == 'capturing' there is the render-first proof (TN1); the a11y 'Capturing' node must then be seen while the fixture is still pending (timeout 250 ms, inside the 300 ms window).
Text proofs use the in-process a11y tree; the OCR step reads the pixels of the same window and needs Screen Recording (ENV-BLOCKED without it, never a FAIL).
The failure message is the fixture's own sentence (it says what failed and what to do, U3), asserted exactly so a generic 'Something went wrong' cannot pass.
View-state fields used: view.phase (README 'Phase 1 view-state contract').
